entities.name: Martyrs' Tomb
entities.description: Memorial in Urborg erected by Freyalise in memory of those who died in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Part of the Burning Isles of the Domains on Dominaria.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Whose mansion once stood where the monument was built.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Bust carried on the Heroes' Obelisk.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Bust carried on the Heroes' Obelisk.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Whose departure with her magic put out the tomb's glyphs.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Visited the tomb in 4557 for inspiration.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Engraved demonic characters on the tomb's inscription.

entities.name: Belzenlok's Cabal
entities.description: Desecrated the tomb, calling it the Fools' Tomb.

events.summary: Freyalise erected the Martyrs' Tomb on the shores of Urborg in memory of those who died in the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The Martyrs' Tomb was erected by the planeswalker Freyalise on the shores of Urborg

events.summary: When Karona left the plane with her magic, the tomb's glyphs went dark and panthers massacred remaining visitors.
events.quote: There was a massacre in that darkness

events.summary: Elspeth and Koth visited the tomb for inspiration while planning an assault on Mirrodin.
events.quote: In 4557, the tomb was visited by Elspeth Tirel and Koth of the Hammer for inspiration

events.summary: Belzenlok's Cabal desecrated the tomb and Belzenlok engraved a warning on the inscription.
events.quote: the tomb had been desecrated by Belzenlok 's Cabal

relations.quote: The Martyrs' Tomb was erected by the planeswalker Freyalise
